notes: Location banner; blank leading lines preserved per convention, 旧 rendered as 'Former'.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00004.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...Then we'll follow the $$レイライン|lc$$ and head
　to the enemy core in the northern central
　continent for a reconnaissance-in-force」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00005.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Understood. We'll use this base as a
　beachhead, gather our forces here, and
　prepare for the decisive battle to come」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00006.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「...Are you really sure about this,
　$$セツコ$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00007.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes...
　take good care of the $$エイクロス$$ I used to pilot」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00008.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Thank you so much!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00009.text:
$$セツコ$$
「...Thank you for everything, $$エイクロス$$.
　Protect him this time」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00011.text:
$$セツコ$$
「It's the unit I fought alongside
　all this time」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00012.text:
$$オリオン$$
「I hope that sentimentality doesn't
　end up destroying you someday」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00013.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「What's your problem...!
　Don't say rude things to $$セツコ$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00016.text:
$$オリオン$$
「Brat... don't get carried away」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00019.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「What's with that guy...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00020.text:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry...
　he can be a bit difficult sometimes...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00021.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's really something, $$セツコ$$, silencing
　$$オリオン$$ with a single word」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00023.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ahh, maybe I should get a makeover too,
　and become the kind of character you'd
　scold, $$セツコ$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00024.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Do you like strong-willed women,
　$$サルディアス$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00026.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「And I also like timid women, women
　who are neither, and men too」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00027.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「You really have no standards, do you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00028.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Please, call me a humanist」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00029.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「...$$セツコ$$'s friends really are
　an odd bunch」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00030.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「There's someone really overbearing,
　and someone who's always counting
　money...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00032.text:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Good luck, $$セツコ$$.
　We'll back you up from the rear」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00033.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you.
　But don't push yourselves too hard」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00034.text:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't do anything that would sadden
　the people who care about you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00040.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「What's wrong, $$ランド$$?
　You don't seem to have your beer...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00041.text:
$$クロウ$$
「We're making camp here tonight.
　No $$サイデリアル$$ detected anywhere
　nearby, so no harm having a drink」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00042.text:
$$ランド$$
「$$クロウ$$... just because we've got a
　sponsor now, aren't you getting a
　little too generous?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00043.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, well. Nonstop fighting's rough,
　but being this well-off materially...
　might be the first time in years」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00044.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's all thanks to $$アドヴェント$$ and
　$$ブルー$$'s knack for procuring supplies.
　Ahh, much appreciated, much appreciated」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00046.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Could it be, $$ランド$$...
　is something wrong with your health?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00049.text:
$$クロウ$$
「N-no... if there's a germ that can get to you,
　the rest of us around you would've
　caught it ages ago」
notes: Orchestrator: あんたにかかる病原菌 = a germ that can infect Rand (joke on his toughness), not one he carries.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00050.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「True enough...
　We'd better get thorough checkups
　right away」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00052.text:
$$クロウ$$
「There you go, finally sounding
　like yourself」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00053.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you hadn't taken the bait,
　I was going to use that forbidden
　nickname」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00054.text:
$$ランド$$
「...Sorry. Thanks for looking out
　for me」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00055.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So, what's up, $$ザ・ヒート$$? Swearing off
　booze means you've got something
　serious on your mind, right?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00057.text:
$$クロウ$$
「Autumn nights are long...
　not that I'm just bored, but
　let's hear it」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00058.text:
$$ランド$$
「...I told $$セツコ$$ about this before,
　but I had a mentor in the repair
　trade」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00059.text:
$$ランド$$
「His name was $$シエロ・ビーター$$. The man
　who literally pounded repair skills,
　a way of living, and a smile into me」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00060.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$ランド$$'s smile...
　That's quite the sinful thing to have done to you...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00061.text:
$$クロウ$$
「...Beater? So he's related to $$メール$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00062.text:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah...
　The old man's $$メール$$'s father」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00063.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「And this "$$メール$$" person is...?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00064.text:
$$ランド$$
「That's... kind of hard to explain...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00069.text:
$$ランド$$
「Ngh... ngh...
　Fine, that'll do for now...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00070.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Since she's $$ランド$$'s fiancée,
　she must be some curvy, glamorous knockout」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00072.text:
$$クロウ$$
「So, what happened to this master of yours?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00073.text:
$$ランド$$
「Right in front of me and $$メール$$, the old man got caught
　in a $$時空震動$$ and vanished...」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00075.text:
$$ランド$$
「So $$メール$$ and I were traveling all over,
　looking for information on the $$時空震動$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00076.text:
$$ランド$$
「Then partway through that trip, the
　$$大時空震動$$ hit, and after that it's just been
　days of fighting, tossed all over the place」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00078.text:
$$ランド$$
「I still haven't even found the old man,
　and now I go and lose track of $$メール$$ too...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00080.text:
$$ランド$$
「...It's not really my style,
　making some kind of vow」
notes: 願掛け rendered as "making some kind of vow" (ties to the abstain-from-drinking vow Rand is keeping until Mel is found).

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00081.text:
$$ランド$$
「But, well, I felt kind of pathetic...
　When the $$スフィア$$ info $$オリオン$$ pulled out
　turned out to be $$セツコ$$'s $$バルゴラ$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00082.text:
$$ランド$$
「Behind the me telling $$セツコ$$ "that's great,"
　there was another me feeling let down
　that it wasn't $$ガンレオン$$ and $$メール$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00083.text:
$$ランド$$
「So if I'm gonna seriously wish for $$メール$$ to be found,
　I figure I oughta at least quit drinking」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00084.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's hot-blooded of you, $$ザ・ヒート$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00085.text:
$$ランド$$
「That's just my way of life」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00088.text:
$$クロウ$$
（That stifling... hot-blooded smile, and a repairman...
　Could it be that, 《That Time》, the one I met was...）
notes: 《あの時》 keyword link labeled "That Time"; recorded in link_labels since it is not a glossary key.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00089.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's no need to be anxious, $$ランド$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00091.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The stars are aligning nicely. I'm sure you'll be
　reunited with the one you long for soon」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00092.text:
$$ランド$$
「...Thanks.
　I'll go ahead and believe that horoscope of yours」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00093.text:
$$ランド$$
「But quitting drinking is my way of settling things.
　At least until $$メール$$ is found,
　I'm keeping it up」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00094.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Enduring pain of your own will...
　You really are the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, after all」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00103.text:
???
「Chant that name...
　Then the $$獅子神$$ will surely lend you strength」

notes: Orchestrator: ガンガン・レオン is a crowd chant splitting Gunleon (ガン=Gun); rendered "Gun-Gun Leon" to keep the echo.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00112.text:
$$セツコ$$
「...$$ガンレオン$$ is a god!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00113.text:
$$市民$$
「Yes, just as Priestess $$メール$$ said,
　when I prayed to the $$獅子神$$, the athlete's foot
　that plagued me for years was cured」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00114.text:
$$市民$$
「When I prayed too,
　my son's rebellious phase settled down」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00116.text:
$$ランド$$
「What's going on here, $$メール$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00117.text:
$$メール$$
「I... after I got caught in that $$時空震動$$, I ended up
　thrown into this town together with $$ガンレオン$$...」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00118.text:
$$メール$$
「Seeing us fall out of the sky, the townspeople made
　a huge fuss, saying a god had come」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00119.text:
$$ランド$$
「Even so, that's way too much of a stretch!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00120.text:
$$メール$$
「I thought so too, but people
　caught up in a $$時空震動$$
　do get anxious, don't they?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00121.text:
$$メール$$
「So I think they just wanted something to cling to」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00123.text:
$$メール$$
「I get what you're saying, darling!
　But there really are people whose wishes
　came true after praying to $$ガンレオン$$...」
notes: Source pid is pid_R_LAND but the jp text's speaker line reads メール, and the content (continuing Mel's argument to Rand, addressing him as "darling") is consistent with Mel speaking, not Rand. Translated the speaker as $$メール$$ per the literal jp text; flagging the pid/text mismatch for orchestrator awareness.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00124.text:
$$メール$$
「And I was wishing to see darling too,
　so look, I got to see you again like this」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00126.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I wouldn't say that」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00128.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Heaven helps those who help themselves...
　I'm sure those people made an effort of their own,
　even as they wished to $$ガンレオン$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00129.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And in times like these...
　everyone is living while enduring pain...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00130.text:
$$ランド$$
「Are you saying $$ガンレオン$$'s $$スフィア$$
　reacted to that and did something?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00131.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's not a bad way to think of it, is it?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00133.text:
$$市民$$
「Is it true that the $$獅子神$$ is leaving town!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00134.text:
$$市民$$
「Lady $$メール$$!
　If that happens, who will protect this town!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00135.text:
$$市民$$
「This time, when we offered prayers to the $$獅子神$$,
　a savior appeared for us, but from now on...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00136.text:
$$ランド$$
「What do we do, $$メール$$?
　Should we prop up $$ランボルト・レオン$$, which is
　basically scrap metal now, as a replacement?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00139.text:
$$市民$$
「Lady $$メール$$!
　Please, put in a good word with the $$獅子神$$!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00140.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's no need to worry!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00142.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Your wishes reached the Lion God!
　No one will attack this town again!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00143.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I myself guarantee it!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00146.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「...Was that all right?
　Saying something like that...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00147.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then we'll just have to make it
　come true, won't we?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00149.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「We're beating back the enemy's new model and
　closing in on their headquarters. On top of that we
　have two Sphere-equipped units」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00150.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「If we keep advancing like this, a town this small,
　with nothing worth taking near the $$レイライン|lc$$,
　will be ignored」
notes: 実害のない, lit. 'no real harm/nothing of real value'; rendered as 'nothing worth taking' to fit natural English without adding meaning

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00151.text:
$$セツコ$$
「So by making ourselves the enemy's target,
　we can save the town」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00152.text:
$$ランド$$
「Nah... it ain't just this town we're saving」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00154.text:
$$メール$$
「So, um... nice to meet you all!
　I'm $$メール・ビーター$$, darling's fiancee!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00155.text:
$$クラヴィア$$
「F-fiancee... you mean $$ランド$$'s!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00156.text:
$$メール$$
「Ah... I'm used to people calling us a beauty and the
　beast couple, so it doesn't bother me」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00160.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「...People's tastes really do vary」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00162.text:
$$メール$$
「Now, now, darling.
　Don't mind other people's jealousy」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00163.text:
$$サルディアス$$
「I can certainly see why one might burn with envy.
　$$ランド$$ was an even hotter man than usual today」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00164.text:
$$メール$$
「Yeah! The way you put your body on the line to
　protect me... I'll never forget it」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00166.text:
$$メール$$
「The power of love is amazing, huh」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00167.text:
$$ランド$$
「I-I just wanted to drink some beer!!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00169.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's no doubt $$ランド$$ cares deeply about you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00171.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My name is $$アドヴェント$$...
　$$メール$$... welcome」
notes: pid field says pid_R_MAIL but the jp speaker line is アドヴェント; used the jp line 1 speaker as the brief specifies

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00172.text:
$$メール$$
「Ah... yes...
　Nice to meet you」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00173.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We depart tomorrow morning. You should finish
　saying your goodbyes to the townspeople before
　then」
notes: Build019: measured dialogue reflow; speaker, wrappers, links and word order preserved.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00175.text:
$$ランド$$
「What's wrong?
　Love at first sight?」
notes: pid field says pid_R_MAIL but the jp speaker line is ランド; used the jp line 1 speaker as the brief specifies

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00176.text:
$$メール$$
「It's not that, but...
　that person...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00063:00177.text:
$$メール$$
「I thought he looked like $$アサキム$$...」
